div.span: No face, plate or identity is ever searched in an outside database or service.

div.span: Each match stores a band, an estimated percent, reason codes and model versions. Gait, height and attributes can shift a band, never decide it.

div.span: Household and known people never trigger alerts. Actions are always taken by a person.
